description.zh: 该参数用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，保证在不同请求间该参数值的唯一性。该参数区分大小写、长度不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: A client token that ensures the idempotence of the request. This value is generated by the client and must be unique for each request. The token is case-sensitive and can be up to 64 ASCII characters long.
The ID of the source cluster.
